facts.fact: ANSUTEN's director general said the R-CUN digital capacity programme, run since 2022 through the Hub numerique, has trained more than 3,200 people, about 40 per cent women, and launched its fourth edition on 7 October 2026 aiming at over 2,000 beneficiaries.
facts.system: R-CUN (Programme de renforcement des capacites a l'usage du numerique)
